title: Owner can replaceDispatcher at an existing index, re-pointing token/metadata under existing holders
description: replaceDispatcher (NFTMinterV2.sol:227-247) is onlyOwner and changes the dispatcher/token/metadata for an index with existing holders. Any 'redemption honored against new token' impact lives in an external redemption layer that is out of scope; no in-scope on-chain redemption keys off the mapping, so no in-scope value impact is demonstrable.
impact: None demonstrable in scope. Existing holders' tokenId now maps to a different dispatcher/token, but no in-scope on-chain redemption depends on the mapping.
attackPath: Owner calls replaceDispatcher(index, newDispatcher); existing holders' tokenId now maps to a different dispatcher/token. No in-scope on-chain redemption keys off the mapping, so no in-scope value impact is demonstrable.
externalRequirements: None in scope; impact would require an external redemption layer.
recommendation: Consider restricting replaceDispatcher to indexes with no existing holders, or document and time-lock the power, so holders cannot have their token/metadata re-pointed underneath them. Note as a design/centralization consideration since impact depends on an out-of-scope redemption layer.
justification: Pure centralization/design-soundness note: wholly owner-gated, no in-scope value impact -> Centralization (C-01) in the QA bundle.
